rows.grounds: expresses arising or manifestation of qualities

items.question: What qualities manifest in the person who attains this exalted divine state?
premises: The person becomes a speaker of truth.
The person becomes free from envy.
items.inference: Attainment of this exalted state entails omniscience, truthfulness, and freedom from envy.
items.plain_english: He becomes all-knowing, truthful in speech, and free from envy.
